scope: Read-only audit of actual hosted jobs, complete retrievable decoded logs, runtime versions, commands, selected gates, and reported outcomes. No source edits, builds, reruns, or human-approval claim by this auditor.

only_difference_from_source_head.meaning: Schedule triggers removed only in the owned CI base; no production, test, POM, or Maven workflow change.

upstream_workflow.default_goals: clean verify apache-rat:check checkstyle:check japicmp:cmp spotbugs:check pmd:check javadoc:javadoc
upstream_workflow.java8_default_goals: clean verify apache-rat:check checkstyle:check japicmp:cmp spotbugs:check pmd:check

interpretation_limits: The Java CI workflow's aggregate success is not an all-jobs pass: its experimental Java 28-ea job failed under continue-on-error:true.
The 18 ordinary jobs have complete archived logs verifying their command, checkout, class and overall test summaries, selected gates, and BUILD SUCCESS.

TypeUtils totals vary with the actual JDK: 461, 506, 510, 524, 528, and 551 for Java 8, 11, 17, 21, 25, and 27. Hosted logs do not enumerate the 14 new parameterized invocations. Local JUnit XML proves their individual fail-before/pass-after results.
A suite's tests count includes skipped cases. Test totals differ by runtime and are retained per job; no sum is presented as unique test coverage.
CodeQL analysis and upload success is separate from test execution and is not proof of zero vulnerabilities.

Nonfatal compiler, SPDX, classpath, metadata PKIX, and missing-analysis-class warnings remain in the logs. Their presence did not fail these default builds; this audit did not run an unchanged control to establish that each warning is pre-existing.
Original log transport bytes are not exposed by the connector. Log digests identify the UTF-8 encoding of its complete decoded text, with returned BOM and line endings retained.

The experimental failure is established by metadata and the coordinator's browser extraction of exact final results: 40 Chuvash date-parser failures, with TypeUtils 551/0/0/1. The selected exact browser lines are archived separately; no complete 16.6-million-character log archive or raw-byte digest is claimed.

The narrow unchanged-upstream Java 28 control reproduces all 40 date-parser failure summaries exactly. It does not run TypeUtils, does not cover the full baseline suite, and does not reproduce the full experimental run's separate major-version-72 instrumentation diagnostics.

warnings_of_note.java8_spdx: All three Java 8 logs report that the SPDX license-list version does not match M.N; the plugin reports this as a warning and the builds succeed.
warnings_of_note.spotbugs: Several runtimes report missing analysis class <bottom>, followed by Done SpotBugs Analysis, BugInstance size 0, Error size 0, and a successful check.
warnings_of_note.pmd: All ordinary jobs contain the plugin's auxiliary-classpath warning and complete the PMD check.
warnings_of_note.javadoc: Javadoc jar generation runs on Java 8; only the final default-cli javadoc:javadoc goal is omitted in the Java 8 profile. Later Javadoc invocations can be up to date because the same build already generated documentation.
